semantic_fidelity.reason: All 17 concepts and 23 directed links are declared, but required repair, reprovision, alerts, register and audit/verify qualifiers are dropped; response label is overwritten, so source meaning is not fully visible.

arrow_traceability.reason: Frame-zero origin is one cell late on sampled arrows, explicitly making direction unproven. Three in-band label-owner ambiguities and region/title collisions further obscure traces.

layout_fit.reason: At pinned 77x47, janitor label and boot response are overwritten; several region titles are lost, and selected/live evidence is actually 83x51, not a live 77x47 pane.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Named conceptual hues exist, but fragmented/missing region titles and apparent border overlap leave membership misleading; phase order is not consistently expressed in the boot view.

border_integrity.reason: The ops region line crosses the janitor box and its interior in v2; selected borders are demonstrated simultaneously for 26 occurrences, not a proof of unobstructed continuous borders.

workflow_evidence.reason: Live app headers prove 83x51, not the required actual 77x47 pane; pinned non-pane dumps cannot replace the required live half-pane. Pane frames contain only 19/71. Some raw attempts are stdout-only without exact command/status, and some rejected specs were overwritten.

animation.reason: Pinned frames contain one dot per route, but the v3 return advances six cells from (36,32) to (34,36) versus five on the other sampled routes; sampled frame-zero dots start one cell late and the v3 dot is on a non-origin corner.

category_fit.reason: The source-backed lifecycle-machines family and one-line evidence are recorded in generation.json, but v3 places machines above boot, S3 and agent at the same rank; boot response returns upward and image/agent phases are simultaneous rather than the requested readable top-to-bottom lifecycle sequence.

findings.description: Required qualifiers lost: repair, reprovision, register, alerts, audit/verify, uploads, and sync. These cannot be recovered from abbreviated captured labels.
v2 janitor─app crosses a node label; v3 boot.ipxe─+─S3 args is visibly overpainted. They are not clean intact text despite placed-label checks.
Region titles and borders are overwritten or absent; v1 jobs top is ──▼j▼bs ───────. A group count does not prove membership geometry.
Three views have an in-band multiple-edge label owner ambiguity; no proof rules out all alternative placements, so budget exhaustion does not waive the gate.
Frame-0 dot first appears one route cell after the true first drawn cell; e.g. v1 control plane (33,10) first cell, dot at (33,11). The checker incorrectly claims origins complete.
A dot beginning away from its arrow origin makes that direction unproven under the gate.

v3 boot return source port is (38,32), first drawn route cell (37,32), but frame 0 dot is on the subsequent corner (36,32), visible as ╭ in later frames. This is not the origin cell; special-cell audit remains incomplete.
v3 return dot moves from (36,32) to (34,36), Manhattan distance six, so cannot advance only five route cells; the blind record mistakenly called it five. Other sampled routes advanced five.
v2 ops region line traverses the janitor box around its middle and text; selected ANSI shows highlighted borders but not intact continuous unobstructed boxes.
Lifecycle-machines is supported and named, but the boot response returns upward and boot, image and agent targets share a single lower rank, not a one-direction phase sequence.
Live pane headers are 83x51, not 77x47; 77x47 frames are pinned dumps, and live pane frame history is truncated to 19/71.

blockers: No actual live 77x47 half-pane capture; pinned target-sized frames cannot prove measured live pane fit.
Actual pane animation captures stop at 19 frames; full-lap pinned dump exists but is not live-pane evidence.
Some earlier rejected specs were overwritten and raw checks lack reproducible commands and exit/stderr separation.
Per-route full-cycle corner and origin audit was not completed; known origin failures remain failures.
The failed left-to-right boot-pair candidate reports no obstacle-safe route; other possible layouts are not disproven.
